purpose: Teach: 毀損/百科/後編/運搬/ネック/選別/結びつける/招か

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Trust is the backbone of any business.
lines.style: Slow, measured delivery. Weight on each word. Long pause after the opening thought. The quiet authority of someone who has watched careers built and destroyed. Calm, almost gentle—not lecturing, simply stating fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社内百科のメンテナンス、継続します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll keep maintaining the internal documentation system.
lines.style: Direct and professional, but not stiff. A note of quiet assurance—he's hearing the weight of the advice and taking it seriously. Slight lean forward in posture. Respectful without being deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 歴史叙述、続編の後編まで丁寧に。
lines.en: The historical records need careful attention through to completion. Don't rush the later sections.
lines.style: Calm instruction, but firm. Each clause lands clearly—not rushed. The tone of someone used to being listened to, but not harsh. A slight pause before 'carefully' to emphasize the precision needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 運搬体制、若手に任せています。
lines.en: I've delegated the distribution responsibilities to the younger staff.
lines.style: Steady, confident tone. A hint of pride in trusting the next generation. Direct eye contact level. Not defensive—simply stating a decision he stands behind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 人事のネック、見極めろ。慎重な選別が要る。
lines.en: Watch for the bottlenecks in personnel. You'll need to be discerning about who fits where.
lines.style: Shifts slightly sharper—still calm, but more pointed. The first clause is direct. A brief pause before the second sentence, letting it sink in. The tone of a mentor passing on something hard-won.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界と結びつける場、引き続き作ります。
lines.en: We'll keep building those bridges with industry partners.
lines.style: Clear acknowledgment of the guidance. Steady tempo. A note of determination beneath the politeness—he's heard the message and is already thinking about execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 招かれる側として、感謝の気持ちを忘れるな。
lines.en: Remember—as the invited guest, never lose sight of your gratitude.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate opening. The opening address lands firmly. Pause. Then the second clause softer, more reflective—almost a benediction. The voice of experience closing a conversation with something that matters.
